card.name: Linking words before a person's name
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas, or relation words (and, wife, daughter, a comma after a title) right before a named family member or associate in biographical text.

modes.label: And or comma before a name
modes.description: An 'and' or comma joins a person to a second named person, such as a spouse or colleague.
modes.example: Adolf Kussmaul was the son of Philipp Jacob Kussmaul (1790-1850)<< and>> Luise Katharina Böhr

modes.label: Relation noun before a name
modes.description: A word like wife, daughter or Queen sits just before the relative's given name.
modes.example: it was decided Mary would share the household duties with<< daughter>>, Nellie Theobald.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward predicting a person's first or last name, such as Spicer or Fernandez.
card.plain: It fires on the small joining word just before the name of a relative or associate in a biography.
